> Blog · Pipeliners · 2026-06-25

# Summary
Part of the batch of 13 blog topic ideas drafted from the 49-post review on June 24-25 and saved to `blog-drafts\` (per the handoff: drafted, not published). Source: `blog-drafts\how-long-does-pipe-lining-last.md`. Each draft carries a focus keyphrase, SEO title, meta, slug, internal link list, image alt ideas and external sources.

# Key facts
- **Focus keyphrase:** how long does pipe lining last.
- **Status:** draft only; not in the July 21 live blog inventory, and no later publish record in this folder.
- Epoxy and CIPP liners built for a 50+ year life; cites NASSCO. Sep 18 research: only 38 searches a month. Uses "pipe lining" as a noun in the focus keyword, which is now against house style.
